name: Reactive-Resume-V4
description: A free and open-source resume builder that simplifies the process of creating, updating, and sharing your resume. It’s 100% free, forever! No ads, no user tracking, just pure resume-building bliss. New features in Reative Resume V4: - A sleek, polished user interface that makes navigation a breeze. - Faster PDF generation to get your resume out there quicker. - Integration with OpenAI for smarter assistance. - Brand new, highly customisable templates to fit your unique style. - Comprehensive documentation with user-friendly guides. - Enhanced security with two-factor authentication. - Available in multiple languages, contributed by the community. - Quality of life features such as locking resumes, adding personal notes to resumes, tracking views and downloads on your public resume etc. IMPORTANT TO NOTE: This container requires 4 additional containers to be configured correctly, up and running or Reactive resume won't work. I have created an installation walkthrough video on YouTube at : https://youtu.be/JTbwzIoJe-A There is also some GitHub documentation at : https://github.com/Eurotimmy/Unraid-templates/blob/main/RxV4/README.md

ports.name: Host Port 1
ports.description: Assign the port you'll use to connect to your resume / cv builder. Adjust this port number if you have a conflict with another container or device already using it.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: URL (and port) to login to your resume / cv builder.

variables.name: STORAGE_URL
variables.description: URL to login to your shared resumes / cvs. Please ensure you append default to the end.

variables.name: CHROME_TOKEN
variables.description: Replace this with your own Chrome token and reflect the same in the browserless/chrome container configuration

variables.name: CHROME_URL
variables.description: URL to your 'browserless/chrome' container. This will produce your PDF versions.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: DB Connection details. postgresql://user:password@address:port/databasename

variables.name: ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET
variables.description: Generate your own token value.

variables.name: REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET
variables.description: Generate your own token value.

variables.name: MAIL_FROM
variables.description: Your email address to send from. RxV4 uses this to validate your account creations with an email confirmation.

variables.name: SMTP_URL
variables.description: Your smtp server details. smtp://user:password@smtpserveraddress:port

variables.name: STORAGE_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Address or IP to MinIO container

variables.name: STORAGE_PORT
variables.description: Port to MinIO container

variables.name: STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: Replace this with your own MinIO user and reflect the same in the 'MinIO' container configuration

variables.name: STORAGE_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Replace this with your own MinIO password and reflect the same in the 'MinIO' container configuration

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Redis connection. redis://default:password@address:port

variables.name: DISABLE_SIGNUPS
variables.description: To disable public signups if you host this facing public Internet (via reverse proxy).

variables.name: DISABLE_EMAIL_AUTH
variables.description: To disable signins all together

variables.name: STORAGE_USE_SSL
variables.description: Is an SSL cert used for the 'MinIO' connection?

variables.name: STORAGE_BUCKET
variables.description: Storage bucket name, put this at the end of STORAGE_URL or just leave on the default

variables.name: STORAGE_REGION
variables.description: Storage bucket region, optional.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: The Node environment setting.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: The Port environment setting. NOTE: I leave this as default (3000) and adjust the host port 1 instead.
